name: inquiryAISession
description: Sends a question to an AI session and returns the answer. Earlier questions and answers in the session are used as context. `aiInquirySession()` is an alias. Lucee 6.2 names it `luceeInquiryAISession()`, which Lucee 7 still accepts.

params.name: question
params.description: The question to send. Pass an array to send multiple parts, such as text together with files or binary data.

params.name: listener
params.description: A function that receives the answer in chunks as they arrive, for streaming.
